name: Thermal IR
desc: A false-color infrared heat map: warm bodies wander and bloom with the bass through an ironbow ramp of black-blue-magenta-orange-white, watched by a flickering thermal-camera HUD.

style.doc: render philosophy: smooth false-color / quantized iso-therm contour bands (abstract schematic) / green phosphor scanline night-vision / inverted x-ray negative

pal.doc: color ramp (ignored by nightvision/xray which force their own)

act.doc: multi-minute program: survey calm drift, pursuit converges + heats, cooldown slowly chills and rewarms
